current: Stage 2/3: accepted profile 2306/24.3 at VRAM 3190. Experimental expert-cache variant preserved: 2048 MiB gives decode 34.03 at VRAM 5242; content differs by a logit shift, cause established, awaiting a correctness decision.

stages.title: Контрольная конфигурация
stages.implemented: git 799a77e, compiler v61 bl87af17a, artifact SHA, build and run commands, model, request and expected e68df05b recorded in runtime/checkpoints/CONTROL-OPT-20261112/config.json; rollback described.

stages.title: Prefill и decode
stages.implemented: Full port retained (307 modules). Root cause of the regression found and fixed: expert mmap pinning was missing. Paired A/B 1619.6 -> 2337.3 prefill (+44%), decode inside noise.
stages.remaining: Prefill 3000 and decode 30 not reached. Decode is cpu-moe bound; prefill needs the remaining ~22% from the graph/quantizer path.

stages.title: RAM и VRAM
stages.implemented: Both historical mechanisms restored: EXP087 lazy compute reservation and EXP101 lazy KV VMM. VRAM 6408 -> 3190 (-3218, -50%), RSS 22857 -> 21319, correctness unchanged.
stages.remaining: Optional: width the compatibility matrix for EXP101; not required for this profile.
stages.dependencies: speed restored on the full port

stages.title: Итоговая проверка
stages.implemented: Short paired A/B -> B/A exists for control vs diagnostic set (A1 1621.1/22.72, A2 1613.2/21.47; B1 2574.2/25.91, B2 2568.2/24.77), every run content-equal.
stages.remaining: Repeat on the accepted full-port configuration and confirm correctness.

events.title: Потеря локализована в libllama
events.detail: CPU library contributes nothing; exp371 line 1588.7 against exp244 line 2567.7 on identical argv.

events.title: Симлинк SONAME стоил ложного замера
events.detail: Repointing only libllama.so.0.7.0 while the loader opens libllama.so.0 produced 1616.8 instead of 2563.2.

events.title: Гибрид экспертов отклонён
events.detail: --n-cpu-moe 34 gives +9% decode but breaks the content check and needs 7578 MiB VRAM.

events.title: Аномалия ctx-checkpoints
events.detail: --ctx-checkpoints 0 changes the output twice with cache_prompt false; kept out of the profile.

events.title: Переключение на exp244 переклассифицировано
events.detail: exp244 libllama has 214 fg modules against 307, so the speedup is diagnostic until the omitted port is accounted for.

events.title: Смешанная сборка GCC 15.2/13.4
events.detail: exp371 contains GCC 15.2.0 and 13.4.0 objects; exp244 is pure 13.4.0 with nearly equal .text. Kill-testing this needs a single-compiler rebuild, not env flags.

events.title: Причина найдена: rpath, а не порт
events.detail: exp244 libllama loads the flint ggml stack through rpath; a pure native libllama on our stack measures 1636/26.04, so the port costs nothing. Remaining work targets our staging ggml stack.

events.title: EXP244 отклонён как оптимизация
events.detail: Igor: replacing the current libllama with EXP244 is a rollback of the port. 2570/25 stays diagnostic only; the full 307-module candidate is the working one.

events.title: ggml исключён
events.detail: Same staging ggml: full port 1624.1, exp244 body 2574.9. Cost is inside the llama translation units, not the library stack.

events.title: Pinning восстановлен: +44% prefill
events.detail: pin_mmap_experts ported into the full 307-module candidate. Paired A/B: 1619.6 without, 2337.3 with. No C++ fallback, no module dropped.

events.title: Эффект pinning воспроизведён
events.detail: Repeat: on 2369.8 / 2361.2, off 1655.6 / 1645.9. +43-44% prefill. The INFO log line is absent, so only the paired A/B counts.

events.title: Decode ограничен профилем cpu-moe
events.detail: Q4K/Q6K goose dots off leave 2378.1/24.48 and 2361.4/23.75 (noise). --no-mmap does not complete. Decode is host GEMV bound at 8 threads.

events.title: Квантайзер CUDA исключён
events.detail: MMQ Q8_1 off 2377.5 and Q6_K matvec off 2360.3, both in noise. Together with batch/KV/graph tests, no switch explains the remaining 9%.

events.title: Decode 32.8 достижим через moe-cache
events.detail: --moe-cache-mib 2048: decode 32.81, prefill 2409.6, VRAM 8456. Content check differs, so it is a lead, not an accepted default. 4096 is OOM.

events.title: EXP087 восстановлен: VRAM -1978
events.detail: Lazy compute reservation was lost from the candidate; restored. VRAM 6408 -> 4430, RSS 22857 -> 21318, speed and exact output unchanged.

events.title: VRAM 6408 -> 3190 (-50%)
events.detail: EXP101 lazy KV VMM restored (-1240 MiB), on top of EXP087 (-1978 MiB). RSS also -1538. Speed and exact output unchanged.

events.title: Decode 34.03 при VRAM 5242
events.detail: Cache 2048 now costs 5242 MiB after EXP087/EXP101 (was 8456). Content differs by a logit shift; both continuations coherent; each arm stable. Variant saved, not enabled.
